issue: तुमहिं भरत कुल पूज्य प्रचारे: 'Bharata proclaimed you worthy of worship in the family' or 'you are proclaimed the one worshipped by the line of Bharata' (भरत कुल).
our reading: Bharata proclaimed you alone worthy of worship in the family.
alternatives: The line of Bharata (Indians) proclaims you its object of worship.

issue: सत्य वचन माने शिव मेरा: 'Śiva holds my word true' or an oath, 'take my word as true, by Śiva'.
our reading: Śiva holds this word of mine true.
alternatives: Take my word for truth; Śiva is my witness.

issue: श्री हरिदास कहै अरु गावै । सो बैकुण्ठ धाम को जावै: हरिदास is read as the poet's name (as in the closing dohā); it could also be 'the servant of Hari who tells and sings it'.
our reading: Śrī Haridāsa tells it and sings it: he (the reciter) goes to Vaikuṇṭha.
alternatives: The servant of Hari who tells and sings it goes to Vaikuṇṭha.

issue: हरिदास हरि कृपा से अवसि भक्ति को पाय: हरिदास is read as the poet's signature ('says Haridāsa'); it could be the reciter called 'a servant of Hari'.
our reading: Whoever recites it for seven days, says Haridāsa, surely gains devotion by Hari's grace.
alternatives: That servant of Hari surely gains devotion by Hari's grace.
